subject: Request: Enterprise onboarding + premium support bundle (Medvale)
messages:
From: Tiernan Roberts <tiernan.roberts@medvale.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@medvale.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Mar 2028 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Request: enterprise onboarding + premium support bundle

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team liked the latency and the routing capabilities. Medvale is ready to move forward with a 3-year deployment across two regions, but we need clarity on two items before legal will sign:

1) Can premium support (24/7 concierge + one dedicated escalation engineer) be included as part of a bundled package?
2) We have a moderate custom integration requirement (HL7 -> Redwood gateway + attribute mapping). We need an onboarding package that covers the engineering work — ideally a fixed-fee SOW.

Budget note: procurement has given us $425k for year one (including any onboarding fees). Any non-standard discounts or credits will need exec approval. Can you confirm whether Redwood can offer a bundled price that keeps us within that number?

Attached is a short integration brief. Happy to hop on a call if helpful.

Best,
Tiernan
Director of Engineering
Medvale Health

Attachment: medvale-integration-brief.pdf (page summary stub)
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Tiernan Roberts <tiernan.roberts@medvale.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Mar 2028 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: enterprise onboarding + premium support bundle

Hi Tiernan — thanks for the clear note and the brief.

Short answer: we can get you premium support bundled, but because the integration scope is custom we need a one-time onboarding SOW and an exec sign-off on concessioned pricing. I'll route this to Deal Desk for a formal ask and circle back with a proposed structure that fits your $425k target.

Proposed next steps (internal):
- I will loop in Ben (deal desk) and Karthik (solutions) to size the SOW and recommend a discount band for the hosted usage.
- If we need an executive price concession we will escalate to Sales Leadership.

Tiernan — can you confirm the absolute must-haves for the HL7 mapping (real-time vs batch) and whether Medvale prefers upfront fees vs staged payments? That determines how far the SOW pushes the year-one spend.

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 07 Mar 2028 12:05:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Request: enterprise onboarding + premium support bundle

Evelyn / Karthik — forwarding Tiernan's ask. Quick sizing from SE side and a recommended concession so I can prepare an exec request:

Karthik, initial read: HL7 -> gateway + attribute mapping looks like ~4 engineering weeks (2 SE + 2 Eng R&D support) + test harness and runbook. Ballpark SOW $60k-$85k depending on third-party connector work.

Pricing options to hit $425k:
- Option A (higher SOW): $85k SOW + $340k year-one usage (minimal discount) — less headroom for discount.
- Option B (lower SOW, more discount): $60k SOW + $365k year-one usage + 15% off usage for year one (requires exec approval).

I recommend Option B with a one-time credit structure: 15% credit off host usage first 12 months plus SOW at $60k. That gets them near $425k. We should ask for an upfront 50% SOW payment + DocuSign sign-off before work starts.

Attaching a quick cost model.

Attachment: Medvale-onboarding-costs.xlsx

Ben
Deal Desk Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 08 Mar 2028 07:20:00 -0800
Subject: Exec approval request: Medvale bundled support + SOW concession

Connor / Marcus — requesting executive sign-off for a non-standard commercial concession on Dea l RW-2028-0875.

Summary: Medvale (prospect) requires premium support to be included in the subscription and a fixed-fee onboarding SOW to deliver a custom HL7 integration. To meet their procurement budget of $425k Y1 we propose: 
- 15% credit on host usage for first 12 months (applied as a monthly credit)
- Fixed SOW: $60,000 to cover integration engineering (estimated 4 weeks)
- Upfront: 50% SOW payment at contract signature, remainder on Milestone 2 (UAT)

Rationale: This preserves ARR while allowing Medvale to roll forward as a reference healthcare account. Without concession they will walk due to procurement limits.

Financial impact: estimated ARR year 1 net of credits ~ $385k. Total company concession (credits + SOW discount) ~ $40k.

Files attached: SOW draft (SOW-Medvale-v2.pdf) and cost model.

Request: Exec approval for the 15% first-year usage credit + approval to accept $60k SOW with 50% upfront. If approved, Ben will finalize SOW and send DocuSign.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Deal Desk Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 08 Mar 2028 09:33:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Exec approval request: Medvale bundled support + SOW concession

Ben — thanks for the clear ask and the financials. I approve an exception but with the following conditions: 
1) Reduce the usage credit to 12% (instead of 15%) to lower the net concession.
2) SOW remains at $60k but require 60% upfront payment (instead of 50%).
3) Legal must confirm that the SOW limits scope creep and includes a time-and-materials cap for out-of-scope items.
4) Marcus, please confirm finance is comfortable recognizing the upfront and the credit amortization.

If Finance/Law are good with the above, proceed to finalize SOW and send DocuSign. Please keep the premium support terms explicit (24/7 concierge, named escalation contact).

Connor O'Brien
VP Sales — Enterprise
Redwood Inference
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Tiernan Roberts <tiernan.roberts@medvale.com>
Cc: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@medvale.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 08 Mar 2028 18:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: enterprise onboarding + premium support bundle

Tiernan — good news: leadership has approved a bundled approach with a small commercial concession. Final agreed terms below: 

- Premium Support: Included (24/7 concierge + named escalation engineer) as part of the subscription.
- First-year usage credit: 12% applied as a monthly credit on usage invoices for the first 12 months.
- Onboarding SOW: Fixed-fee $60,000 (HL7 gateway + attribute mapping; estimated 4 weeks).
  - Payment: 60% due at signature, remainder due on UAT completion.
  - Scope: SOW draft attached. Out-of-scope items flagged to be T&M with a cap; will require written change order.
- Next steps: Ben will send the SOW via DocuSign and the contract amendment link. Please sign the SOW and return 60% to initiate work.

I attached the SOW and cost summary for your review. Happy to join a quick call to walk through the SOW if you'd like.

Thanks and excited to get Medvale onboarded.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOW-Medvale-v2.pdf, Medvale-onboarding-costs.xlsx
DocuSign: https://docusign.example.com/envelope/0a1b2c3d
